integrity: Analytic all-dimension proof and separately runnable numerical corroboration; historical novelty remains subject to further specialist literature review.
scientific_limitations: Real Euclidean second-order cone with unweighted ambient coordinate maximum norm; excludes non-Euclidean metric projections, weighted cones and general linear cone images. Global supremal constants may be approached through local derivatives.
title: Sharp coordinatewise Lipschitz transition for Euclidean Lorentz-cone projection
